info.long_name: Proportion of students exempt from DTaP vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption from the DTaP vaccination requirement.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding an exemption of any kind from the DTaP series. This is an exemption rate, not a coverage rate: a student without an exemption is not necessarily vaccinated, and an exempt student may still have received the vaccine, so it cannot be subtracted from one to obtain coverage.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were exempt from DTaP vaccination.

mo_school_immunization.name: Missouri School Immunization Data
mo_school_immunization.organization: Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services
mo_school_immunization.description: County-level per-series EXEMPTION rates from the Missouri DHSS school immunization dashboard, workbook "Exemption Rates for Kindergarteners in Missouri Schools, by Vaccine Series", covering kindergarten, 7th grade and K-12. Medical, religious and total are reported for each series. EXEMPTIONS ONLY -- this source publishes no coverage, so the coverage columns are empty. Do not compute coverage as 1 minus these values: a student without an exemption is not necessarily vaccinated, and an exempt student may still have received the vaccine. Medical and religious do not always sum exactly to the reported total, since each is rounded to three decimals at source.
mo_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
